relationship_type: Information / reporting (notification of designated entities)
modality: shall (notify in CS-P03-001; inform in CS-P03-002)
condition: Entities are established in the Community and designated by the Member States for Article 9 procedures: certification, product checks and associated surveillance tasks (bodies, with identifying symbols); tests (laboratories)
cross_provisions_used: Article 9 (read only to resolve 'procedures referred to in Article 9'; not needed to identify the parties)
authority: Duty-bearer is the Member States. No power of the Commission to accept, reject, review or act on the information is stated in these statements; no authority attribute coded for the Commission.
discretion: Not coded (mandatory 'shall'; no choice indicators in the two statements).
accountability: Information component only (A to B). No forum assessment, justification duty or consequence is stated; not coded as accountability.
decision_reason: Both parties are named; a governance-relevant action (information duty) with direction, modality and condition is stated. The two statements share the same typed dyad and the same instrument (notification to the Commission) and differ only in the object (bodies vs laboratories), so they support one relationship; the alternative of two relationships is recorded in U-03.

actor_b: Bodies designated for Article 9 procedures (category; termed 'notified bodies' elsewhere in the Directive)
relationship_type: Delegation / authorization (designation of conformity-assessment bodies)
modality: None expressed (designation is an antecedent fact in the relative clause 'which they have designated')
condition: Bodies established in the Community; designated for certification, product checks and associated surveillance tasks pertaining to Article 9 procedures
authority: The bodies' capacity to carry out the named tasks derives from designation by the Member States (derivation: conferred by designation). Bindingness, scope limits and legal consequence of the bodies' acts are not stated in the statement; not coded.
discretion: Not coded (nothing stated on Member State discretion in designating or on the bodies' discretion).
accountability: None constituted in the statement (no information, justification, assessment or consequence between the designated bodies and the Member States).
decision_reason: Designation is textually expressed with both parties identifiable. Accepted at relation level only, with the thin content available: the statement describes the designation as an antecedent, it does not enact it, and its operative act is notification (U-01).

actor_b: Test laboratories designated for Article 9 procedures (category)
relationship_type: Delegation / authorization (designation of test laboratories)
modality: None expressed (designation is an antecedent fact in the relative clause 'which they have designated')
condition: Laboratories established in the Community; designated for carrying out tests pertaining to Article 9 procedures
authority: Laboratories' capacity to carry out tests derives from designation by the Member States (derivation: conferred by designation). Legal consequence of test results is not stated; not coded.
discretion: Not coded (as R-P03-02).
decision_reason: Same reasoning as R-P03-02, for laboratories. Kept separate from R-P03-02 because the designated counterpart class and the designated task differ (U-01).

relationship_type: Verification / assurance (assessment of the quality system)
condition: To determine whether the quality system satisfies the requirements referred to in point 3.2
cross_provisions_used: Annex III point 3.2 (quoted in the statement; shows the quality system is the one adopted by the manufacturer); Annex III point 3.1 (owner: 'his quality system'); Annex III point 6 and Art. 10(1) (term 'notified body' = bodies referred to in Art. 10(1); used only for C-P03-03)
authority: Capacity to assess conformity of the quality system with point 3.2. The legal consequence of the assessment (for instance for the manufacturer's standing) is not stated in the frozen statements and is not coded.
discretion: Not coded: the criteria are referred to (point 3.2) but whether the body has interpretive or assessment judgment cannot be determined from the statement; no discretion is inferred from the role.
accountability: None constituted: no duty of the body to inform, justify or answer to a forum appears in this statement (decision notification is CS-P03-004, deferred).
decision_reason: The notified body is expressed. The second party is not named in the sentence but is fixed by the quoted cross-reference to point 3.2 and by point 3.1 of the same annex; the connection (verification) is stated. Status therefore cross_provision_inference (U-04).

relationship_type: Verification / assurance (periodic audit under surveillance)
condition: At reasonable intervals; to make sure that the manufacturer maintains and applies the quality system
authority: Capacity to audit the manufacturer's maintenance and application of the quality system. Legal consequence of audit findings and any power of entry or sanction are not stated in the statement; not coded.
discretion: Indicator present: audit frequency is framed by the open-textured standard 'reasonable intervals' (range not otherwise specified; reviewability and justification not stated). Degree not graded (U-08).
accountability: None constituted in the statement (the report is CS-P03-006).
decision_reason: Both parties expressed; action, modality, purpose and timing condition stated. Kept separate from R-P03-04 because the instrument and procedural step differ (initial assessment vs periodic audit).

relationship_type: Information / reporting (audit report to the audited party)
condition: Follows the audit required in the same sentence
authority: None stated beyond the duty to provide the report; the effect of the report is not stated.
discretion: Not coded (no choice indicators).
accountability: Information component only, directed to the audited party. The recipient is not stated to have any power to assess or sanction the notified body; not accountability (see R-P03-10).
decision_reason: Both parties expressed; direction and recipient explicit; coordinated second action registered separately in the frozen register and kept as a separate typed relation because the type (information) differs from R-P03-05 (verification).

actor_a: Not expressed in the sentence (candidates: notified body; auditing team of the notified body)
relationship_type: Information / reporting (notification of the assessment decision with reasons)
condition: The notification contains the conclusions of the examination and the reasoned assessment decision
cross_provisions_used: Annex III point 3.3, neighbouring sentences read for context; not used to supply the actor
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
accountability: Textual components present: information and reasons (justification) owed to the manufacturer. Forum assessment power and consequence are not stated; no accountability relation is constituted, and the duty-bearer is unexpressed.
decision_reason: The actor is not expressed (passive). Supplying the notified body would be an inferred actor; the same paragraph also mentions an 'auditing team', so the reading is not forced by the text. The recipient is expressed. Retained as a statement-level assignment pending human decision (U-06).

relationship_type: Oversight / supervision (Commission control over Member State designations)
condition: None
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: The statements give the Commission only the position of recipient of information; no power to approve, reject, review or respond is stated. Treating receipt as oversight would convert a unilateral duty into a relation (U-11). coding_status/claim_level describe the retained statement, not the rejected relation.

relationship_type: Oversight / supervision (control of designated bodies by the Member States)
condition: None
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: Only designation and notification are expressed; no monitoring, approval, review or withdrawal power appears in the frozen statements (U-11). Wider provisions of the Directive were not used to supply it.

relationship_type: Accountability (notified body answerable to the audited manufacturer)
condition: None
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: The audit report is information supplied to the auditee. No power of the manufacturer to question, assess or impose consequences on the notified body is stated; reporting alone is information, not accountability (U-09).

relationship_type: Delegation / authorization (approval of the quality system)
condition: None stated in the frozen statements
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: An approving or authorizing effect of the assessment decision is not stated in the frozen statements; 'decision' appears only in CS-P03-004, whose actor is unexpressed. The effect would have to come from text outside the frozen set (U-05).

actor_a: Independent auditor (grammatical subject 'independent audit' in CS-P04-001; role 'the auditor' in CS-P04-002)
relationship_type: Information / reporting (audit findings)
condition: At the end of the phased registration; audit performed at the expense of the Registry
authority: Duty to report findings. No power of the Commission to assess, approve or act on the findings is stated in the statement.
discretion: Not coded (no choice indicators; the scope of the audit is not stated in the statement).
accountability: Information component (findings to the Commission) only. Forum assessment and consequence are not stated in the frozen statements; accountability of any audited party is not established (R-P04-05 deferred).
decision_reason: The party is the audit as grammatical subject, tied to 'the auditor' in the next sentence of the same paragraph; no natural-person actor is inserted. Direction, modality and condition are stated (U-12).

relationship_type: Delegation / authorization (appointment of the independent auditor)
condition: After consulting the Commission
authority: The Registry holds the appointing power; the auditor's role derives from the appointment (derivation: conferred by appointment). Bindingness and legal effect of the audit are not stated. 'Independent' is a textual qualifier of the audit and is not coded as an attribute of independence from the Registry.
discretion: Registry's choice of auditor is conditioned on prior consultation of the Commission; no selection criteria are stated; range not otherwise specified; not graded.
accountability: None constituted by the statement between auditor and Registry.
decision_reason: Both parties expressed (Registry as agent of the passive), connection (appointment) and modality stated.

relationship_type: Representation / participation (consultation before appointment)
direction: Registry -> Commission (consults); Commission input precedes the appointment
modality: Precondition inside 'shall be appointed ... after consulting' (the consultation duty is carried by the condition, not by a separate modal verb)
condition: Before the auditor is appointed
authority: Commission is consulted; no consent, veto or binding effect is stated (contrast CS-P04-010, which states 'consent').
discretion: The Registry retains the choice; no obligation to follow the Commission's view is stated; the effect of consultation is not specified.
decision_reason: Thin relation: parties and procedural connection are expressed, effect is unspecified (U-15). Recorded as minimal participation with no claim of control over the Registry.

relationship_type: Contractual / exchange or resource dependency (funding of the audit)
modality: shall ('shall be performed at the expense of the Registry')
condition: None stated
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: The cost-bearer is stated; payee, mechanism and any bearing on independence are not. No financial dependence of the auditor is inferred (U-14).

actor_b: Registry (candidate audited party; not stated in the frozen statements)
relationship_type: Verification / assurance (audit of an actor's administration)
condition: At the end of the phased registration
cross_provisions_used: Article 12(5), third sentence (purpose of the audit) read for context; NOT used (outside the frozen statements)
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: The audited party and object are not stated in either frozen statement; they appear in a further sentence of the same paragraph that is not in the register. Using it would widen the evidence base beyond the 20 statements (U-13).

relationship_type: Delegation / authorization (selection of validation agents)
condition: In an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner, ensuring the widest possible geographical diversity
authority: The Registry holds the power to select; the agents' role derives from selection (derivation: conferred by selection). The legal effect of validation by the agents is not stated in this statement.
discretion: Constrained choice: stated manner criteria and a diversity objective; range of candidates not specified; reviewability and justification not stated. Qualitative only, not graded.
decision_reason: Both parties expressed; connection (selection), modality and conditions stated.

relationship_type: Authority / control (requirement of conduct in validation)
condition: Validation to be executed in an objective, transparent and non-discriminatory manner
authority: The Registry is to require specified conduct from the agent, a directive capacity. The device through which the requirement is imposed, and any sanction, are not stated.
discretion: No discretion coded for the Registry. The agent's discretion in validation is bounded by the three manner criteria, but its range is not stated; not coded.
accountability: None: no information, justification, assessment or consequence mechanism is stated.
decision_reason: Both parties expressed; the 'require' connection, modality and condition are stated. Separate from R-P04-06 because the type (control) and the act differ (U-16).

actor_b: Validation agent indicated by the Registry
relationship_type: Information / reporting (submission of documentary evidence for verification)
condition: Evidence shows that the applicant holds the prior right claimed; submitted to an agent indicated by the Registry
authority: Applicant's duty. The agent's receiving position carries no stated power in this statement (examination is CS-P04-006).
discretion: None coded; no applicant choice of agent is stated (the agent is the one indicated by the Registry).
accountability: Information component only (evidence from applicant); no forum assessment in this statement.
decision_reason: Both parties expressed (applicant; validation agent as recipient); direction, modality and condition stated. The Registry's indication is kept out of this relation (see R-P04-09).

actor_b: Validation agent or applicant (addressee of the indication not stated)
relationship_type: Authority / control or authorization (indication of the validation agent for an application)
modality: None stated (participial qualifier 'indicated by the Registry')
condition: None
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: The statement does not say to whom, how or on what basis the agent is indicated. A Registry-to-agent link already exists through R-P04-06; a separate indication relation would need inference about the mechanism (U-17).

actor_b: Applicant that is first in line
relationship_type: Verification / assurance (examination of the prior-right claim)
condition: Applicant is first in line to be assessed and has submitted the documentary evidence before the deadline
authority: Capacity to examine whether prior rights exist. The legal effect of the agent's finding on the applicant is not stated in the frozen statements; not coded.
discretion: The statement specifies no standard, range or constraint for the examination; discretion not coded (none inferred from the role).
accountability: None constituted by this statement (outcome notification is R-P04-11, to the Registry).
decision_reason: Both parties identifiable (the agent expressed; the applicant described by a condition); the connection (verification) is stated. How an agent becomes 'relevant' is not stated (U-19).

relationship_type: Information / reporting (notification of the validation outcome)
condition: Branch 1 (CS-P04-007): documentary evidence not received in time OR agent finds it does not substantiate a prior right. Branch 2 (CS-P04-008): agent finds prior rights exist regarding the first-in-line application
authority: Duty to notify. The Registry's power to act on the notification is not stated in these statements.
discretion: The agent's finding precedes the notification; its standard and range are not stated; not coded.
accountability: Information component only (outcome to the Registry). Reasons are not required by these statements, the Registry's assessment of the agent is not stated and no consequence is stated; not coded as accountability (see R-P04-12).
decision_reason: Both parties expressed. The two statements share the same typed dyad and the same instrument (notification to the Registry) and differ only in the condition branch, which is preserved in the condition field; the alternative of two relationships is recorded in U-20.

relationship_type: Accountability (validation agent answerable to the Registry)
condition: None
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: The combination of a conduct requirement (R-P04-07) and outcome notifications (R-P04-11) is not an accountability relation on this text: no duty to justify, no assessment power of the Registry over the agent and no consequence is stated. Promoting it would treat reporting as accountability (U-21).

actor_b: Reputable trustee or other escrow agent established within the Community (category)
relationship_type: Contractual / exchange (escrow agreement)
modality: shall (Registry's duty to enter into the agreement)
condition: At the Registry's own expense; agent established within the territory of the Community; agreement designates the Commission as beneficiary
authority: The Registry has a duty to conclude the agreement. The agreement's terms are not in the statement; Article 15(2) is not coded.
discretion: The Registry's choice of escrow agent is bounded by textual qualifiers (reputable; established in the Community); selection procedure not stated; not graded.
accountability: None constituted by the statement between Registry and escrow agent.
decision_reason: Both parties expressed (the escrow agent as an actor category, no instance invented); connection (agreement) and modality stated.

actor_a: Parties to the escrow agreement (Registry; escrow agent)
relationship_type: Beneficiary / protective (Commission as beneficiary of the escrow agreement)
modality: Designation stated as content of the agreement
condition: None stated
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: What the beneficiary may claim or do is not stated in the frozen statements (the terms are in Article 15(2), outside the register). A beneficiary relation without content would be only a label (U-22).

relationship_type: Oversight / supervision (prior approval: consent to the escrow agreement)
condition: Before the agreement is concluded
authority: Approval position over a contract of the Registry: consent precedes conclusion. Whether consent is a necessary condition of validity or can be withheld, and the consequence of its absence, are not stated.
discretion: Not coded: 'shall give its consent' states a duty; no criteria for giving or refusing and no range are stated (U-23).
decision_reason: The Commission is expressed. The Registry is identified as party to 'that agreement' through the preceding statement of the same paragraph (convention: label cross_provision_inference for a second party supplied by another statement, U-24). Authority attributes limited to what the text supports.

relationship_type: Oversight / supervision (consent directed to the escrow agent)
condition: None
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: Consent is given 'to that agreement'; the escrow agent is a party to the agreement but nothing states a connection from the Commission to the escrow agent. Not inferred.

relationship_type: Information / reporting (data deposit: electronic copy of the current .eu database content)
condition: On a daily basis
authority: Duty of the Registry. The escrow agent's powers over the data are not stated in the statement.
discretion: None coded (frequency fixed: daily).
accountability: None constituted: a deposit with an escrow agent is not a report to a forum; no assessment or consequence is stated.
decision_reason: Both parties expressed ('the escrow agent' refers to the agent of CS-P04-009, U-24); direction, modality and frequency stated. Separate from R-P04-13 because the act and instrument differ (agreement vs deposit).

actor_a: Complainant (named only as chooser of the provider; the submitter of complaints is not expressed)
actor_b: ADR provider chosen from the list in Article 23(1)
relationship_type: Review / adjudication (access to the complaints procedure: complaint submission and choice of provider)
condition: Provider chosen by the complainant from the list referred to in the first paragraph of Article 23
cross_provisions_used: Article 23(1), second sentence (the list is published on the Registry's website); used only to read the cross-reference
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Explicit choice indicator at statement level: provider 'chosen by the complainant' from a list (range = the list). Not promoted to a relation attribute while the relation is deferred.
decision_reason: The duty-bearer of the submission is not expressed. 'Complainant' is lexically implied for complaints but appears in the sentence only as chooser, and nothing identifies who submits the responses. Retained as a statement-level assignment pending human decision (U-25).

actor_a: Submitter of responses (not named in the statement)
relationship_type: Review / adjudication (submission of responses)
condition: None stated
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: No party for the responses is identifiable in the statement or in its quoted cross-reference; the responses part is retained as an assignment only. Naming a respondent would be an inferred actor (U-25).

relationship_type: Information / reporting (notification of complainant identity and domain name)
condition: As soon as an ADR request is properly filed with the provider and the appropriate fee is paid
authority: Duty of the provider. The Registry's subsequent action is not in the statement and is not coded.
discretion: None coded (event-triggered duty; no choice indicators).
accountability: Information only; no forum assessment, justification or consequence is stated.
decision_reason: Both parties expressed; direction, modality and trigger condition stated. Who files and who pays is not expressed (passive condition) and is not coded (U-27).

relationship_type: Delegation / authorization (selection of ADR providers)
condition: Providers are reputable bodies with appropriate expertise; selection read as objective, transparent and non-discriminatory (grammatical attachment of the manner phrase is ambiguous)
cross_provisions_used: Article 23(1), second sentence (published list), used only for the coupling with CS-P04-012 at configuration level
authority: The Registry holds a permissive power to select; the providers' role derives from selection (derivation: conferred by selection). Adjudicative authority of the providers is not in the frozen statements.
discretion: Explicit indicator: power framed permissively ('may'), constrained by stated qualifications and manner. Reviewability and justification not stated. Qualitative only.
decision_reason: Both parties expressed; connection (selection) and permissive modality stated (U-28).

relationship_type: Information or authority (Registry's list as constraint on the complainant's choice)
condition: None
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: No direct legal connection between Registry and complainant is stated. The shared reference to the list couples R-P04-18 and R-P04-21 and is carried at configuration level (C-P04-04), not as an edge (U-26).

relationship_type: Authority / control (requirement of conduct of ADR providers)
condition: None
authority: Not coded.
discretion: Not coded.
decision_reason: Unlike CS-P04-004 (validation agents), CS-P04-014 states no power to require conduct: the qualifications and manner are conditions on selection. Parallel wording with Article 13 is not treated as a relationship.
